name: Aircall
summary: Cloud phone system for sales and support teams: call routing, analytics and CRM integrations.
best_for: sales and support teams (3+ seats) that want a polished cloud phone system embedded in their CRM/helpdesk, with call routing, analytics and 250+ integrations
skip_if: you're a solo operator or duo (the 3-license minimum prices you out), or you need a full contact-center suite with omnichannel routing
honest_knock: Two structural catches: the 3-seat minimum makes the real starting price triple the sticker, and the annual-vs-monthly gap is steep (Professional: $50 vs $70). 'Unlimited calling' covers listed regions — check yours — and AI features increasingly live in add-ons or higher tiers. It's polished and integration-rich; just price the seats you'll actually have, on the billing cycle you'll actually choose.

pricing.plans_source: summarised from pricing.notes; every plan name and amount appears verbatim in those notes
pricing.notes: (read 2026-08-26 on aircall.io/pricing over a US connection, with their own country selector on United States) Essentials is $30 per license a month and Professional $50, both on annual billing, which the page marks as 25% off monthly. Flip that toggle and the monthly rates read $40 and $70 per license (3 licenses for $120 and $210), checked 29 August 2026 from a US connection. The discount is not uniform either: Essentials really is 25% off, but Professional lands closer to 29%, so price the plan you will actually buy rather than trusting the badge; the same cards quote 3 licenses at $90 and $150 a month. Custom starts at 25 licenses. Aircall AI is mostly not in those numbers (re-read 27 September 2026 in the USD offer data Aircall publishes on aircall.io/pricing): AI Assist is $9 per licence a month and AI Assist Pro $49, though Professional includes the AI Assist features. AI Voice Agents come with 50 free minutes per account a month (plus 100 at sign-up), then $175 for 500 minutes or $725 for 2,500, $0.49 a minute pay-as-you-go dropping to $0.39 above 2,500, and custom bundles from $0.19 a minute above 10,000. AI Messaging Agents are priced per conversation; the page served to us from the Netherlands showed EUR 0.13-0.30 per conversation, and the US offer data does not list them. Other add-ons: Analytics+ $15, WhatsApp $10 plus WhatsApp's own messaging rates, all per licence a month, so the licence fee is a floor rather than the bill. Our 26 August reading listed AI conversations at $0.35 each; that line is no longer on the page.
